svg.text: Duplo: outbound GTM system, end to end
svg.textArea: Drawn from context/docs/gtm-system.md (v1 design, 2026-11-12, nothing built yet). Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right. TBD marks open decisions.
svg.text: 2 Route, find people and write the message

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
• ICP, personas, signal matrix
• facts.md, weekly priorities

1C Buying signals
• W1 Turnover band (NGX)
• W2 Outlet count up
• W3 Finance, AP, tax hiring
• W4 New finance leader
• W5 Recent funding
• W6 Several banks
• W7 New CBN licence (off)

1E Find companies
One row per domain, signals stack

1G Enrich
Cheap fields first, then paid columns

1I Priority 1
₦1bn+ turnover and a B pattern

2C S2 QSR and retail
Expenses, approvals, bulk payouts

2D S3 Logistics, manufacturing
Global payments, vendor payouts

2F Find people
• Champion: finance ops lead
• Buyer: CFO, or CEO if small
• Influencer: tax or ERP (U1 only)

2H Find and verify email
Waterfall, then validator (TBD)

2J Write the copy
• Approved spec, then /campaign-copy
• Signal opener, facts.md proof

3A Send the sequence
• 3 emails, 2 LinkedIn steps
• Stop on any reply
• LinkedIn tool TBD

3B Sort replies
AI tags intent, low confidence to a human

3C HubSpot CRM
Company, contact and deal properties

3E Customer
Proof in facts.md only if they approve

3F Weekly review
• Positive reply rate decides
• Keep, change or kill workflows
• Write back to the Context OS
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
